data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table (gross of reinsurance) the syndicate shows favourable prior-year development overall: aggregating movements for underwriting years up to 2016 produces a net release on prior years of approximately GBP 60.1m (gross). The report also references net prior-year releases in its technical results (net of reinsurance) but a gross movement figure is not clearly presented elsewhere; the gross figure above was calculated from the gross claims development table.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was computed from the gross claims development table (pages 39-40). The report contains statements referring to net releases (net of reinsurance) elsewhere but no clear gross 'movement in prior years' line was found; therefore the gross PYD above is calculated from the claims development triangle by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2016 (per the instructions). Numbers in the triangle were presented in thousands in the report and have been converted to millions here. Opening (1 Jan 2018) gross claims outstanding on the balance sheet was not unambiguously located in the images provided, so opening_reserves_gbp_m is null. Exact verbatim narrative describing the prior-year movement was not clearly legible in the provided images, so exact_reserve_text is left blank.
